name: TruncGradGS
definition: A modification to the 3DGS rasterization gradient computation that replaces near-zero Gaussian derivative tails with a linear surrogate to solve the vanishing gradient problem in dynamic scenes with large inter-frame displacements.
summary: TruncGradGS modifies 3D Gaussian Splatting by replacing near-zero gradient tails with linear surrogates to maintain gradient flow for discarded primitives in dynamic scenes.
